usage: Use 踢足球 as a noun phrase for the sport of football/soccer; it is common in everyday spoken Cantonese.
In Hong Kong, people often say 踢足球 when they mean playing football, not watching it.
It can work after verbs like 鍾意, 想, 去, or 學, for example in hobby or activity contexts.
For young learners, this is a very common sports word, and it sounds natural in both school and casual conversation.
